steps.label: Requisitions-ddl
steps.sql: CREATE TABLE Requisitions(id INT64 NOT NULL,State INT64) PRIMARY KEY(id)

steps.label: Measurements-ddl
steps.sql: CREATE TABLE Measurements(MeasurementId INT64 NOT NULL) PRIMARY KEY(MeasurementId)

steps.label: subquery-update-0
statements:
UPDATE Requisitions
SET State = 5
WHERE
  State IN (1,2)
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT
      MeasurementId
    FROM
      Measurements
    LIMIT 1
  );
